json.reply: Relief diver, eh? Took them long enough. Cells are eighteen chits until topside pays me, and yes, I'm rationing too. If you want a couple free, put three of those company drones in the bilge. They've been coring the pipework.

actions.title: Bilge the Drones
actions.description: Quill wants three Sampling Drones driven off before they core through the habitat's pipework. He'll pay in lamp cells.
